name: TableMaster for Elementor – Responsive Data Tables & Comparison Tables
author: BloomPixel

sections.description:
TableMaster for Elementor is a dedicated table builder for the Elementor page builder. Create comparison tables, pricing tables, product tables, and data-rich tables with live styling, responsive stack and scroll modes, CSV import, and Google Sheets sync. No shortcodes. No HTML. No switching between plugins.

Unlike generic addon packs that bundle a basic table among 80+ widgets, TableMaster is built by a team that takes tables seriously. Affiliate bloggers use it to launch comparison pages in minutes. WooCommerce stores use it for product catalogs. Agencies use it for menus, schedules, and directories that update from a Google Sheet.

Seamlessly Integrated With Elementor

TableMaster brings advanced table addons for Elementor, helping you build stylish and functional tables without coding.

You can drag the Elementor table widget into your layout, start adding content, apply styles, and instantly see the results with live editing.

You don’t need to switch screens or refresh the page to preview changes.

Everything happens visually inside Elementor’s native environment.

This lets you:

  • Save time on repetitive tasks
  • Avoid manual HTML table formatting
  • Keep your table design aligned with the rest of your Elementor pages
  • Avoid the hassle to style for multiple devices as this Elementor responsive table adapts seamlessly to all screen sizes and resolutions

Why Choose TableMaster for Elementor?

TableMaster brings the simplicity of Excel and the flexibility of Elementor together in one powerful, easy-to-use plugin.

With real-time visual editing, dynamic data support, and advanced styling controls, TableMaster gives you complete control over how your data is displayed, with no workarounds or external tools needed. In short, it is perfect Elementor table builder for every kind of user.

This plugin is perfect for marketers, eCommerce stores, educators, and anyone who needs to present structured data in an organized, professional format.

Whether you’re migrating from TablePress, building your first comparison page, or running a WooCommerce catalog, TableMaster is built to slot directly into your Elementor workflow.

TableMaster Features – Everything You Need to Get Started

TableMaster is the powerful tools to build beautiful and responsive tables with ease within Elementor editor.

Built natively into Elementor

  • True Elementor widget — no shortcodes, no iframe workarounds
  • Live drag-and-drop editing inside the Elementor canvas
  • Works with Elementor Free and Elementor Pro

Connect any data source

  • Manual entry with intuitive cell editor
  • Import from CSV files (upload, paste, or URL)
  • Import from JSON
  • One-click migration from TablePress
  • Pro: Live sync from Google Sheets
  • Pro: Dynamic data from WordPress posts, custom post types, taxonomies, users
  • Pro: WooCommerce product tables

Built for mobile

  • Two responsive modes: Stack (rows reflow) and Scroll (horizontal swipe)
  • Per-breakpoint styling controls

Interactive out of the box

  • Sortable columns (click headers to sort)
  • Real-time search filtering
  • Pagination for large tables
  • Row count and table info display

Deep styling controls

  • Header, row, and per-cell typography, colors, borders, padding
  • Alternating row backgrounds
  • Column span and row span for complex layouts
  • Icons and buttons inside cells

Advanced cell features

  • Pro: Add tooltips on any cell for extra context without cluttering the table

Use Cases – What Can You Create with TableMaster for Elementor?

TableMaster is incredibly versatile and works great for almost any website.

Here are just a few examples of what you can build:

  • Comparison tables for affiliate blogs
  • Product pricing tables for service providers
  • Restaurant menus with multiple sections
  • Course schedules for education websites
  • Employee directories with contact info
  • Event listings with dates and times
  • FAQs and knowledge base content
  • Data-rich dashboards and reports

sections.faq:
Can I use TableMaster with the free version of Elementor?

Yes! TableMaster is fully compatible with both Elementor Free and Pro versions.

Is TableMaster optimized for speed?

Yes, TableMaster is built with performance in mind and won’t slow down your website.

How do I create a comparison table in Elementor?

To create a comparison table in Elementor, drag the TableMaster widget onto your page and choose the Content Table layout. Add your products or items as columns, fill in the rows for each feature you want to compare, then style headers, highlights, and CTAs visually. The result is a fully responsive comparison table in Elementor that you can edit live without touching shortcodes or HTML.

How do I import a Google Sheets to a WordPress table?

With TableMaster Pro, you can import a Google Sheets file into a WordPress table by connecting your sheet URL inside the Data Table widget. Once linked, the WordPress table syncs automatically whenever you update the Google Sheets source, so your published data stays current. This makes Google Sheets to WordPress table imports ideal for pricing lists, schedules, and inventories that change often.

How do I make an Elementor table responsive on mobile?

Every TableMaster widget includes built-in responsive controls, so it just takes a mouse click to turn normal tables into responsive tables. Pick Stack to convert rows into mobile-friendly cards, or Scroll to keep the original layout with horizontal scrolling on smaller screens.

How do I import a TablePress table into Elementor?

TableMaster lets you import a TablePress table into Elementor directly from the Data Table widget. Just select the TablePress source and pick the table you want to use, and TableMaster will load it into Elementor with full styling and responsive controls applied. This is the easiest way to migrate an existing TablePress table into Elementor without rebuilding your data from scratch.

Can I sort and filter table columns in Elementor?

Yes, TableMaster lets you sort and filter table columns in Elementor with a single toggle. Enable Sortable Columns so visitors can reorder data by clicking any header, and turn on the Search Box to filter table rows in real time. Combined with pagination, these controls make it easy to build searchable, sortable Elementor tables for large datasets.

How do I create a WooCommerce product table in Elementor?

With TableMaster Pro, you can create a WooCommerce product table in Elementor by selecting WooCommerce as the data source inside the Data Table widget. Choose the product fields you want to display, like image, title, price, SKU, or stock, and TableMaster will generate a styled WooCommerce product table that updates as your store changes. It’s a great way to build catalogs, order forms, and quick-buy layouts directly inside Elementor.
